title: Singapore HDB carpark occupancy in Clementi, Saturday 20:00
brief: Revision 2 (owner decisions applied). Entrants forecast the share of car lots taken across the HDB (public-housing) carparks of the Clementi planning area at Saturday 20:00 Singapore time, computed by SSA from the keyless Carpark Availability snapshot on data.gov.sg; SSA defines and resolves the metric. HDB only; mall carparks (DataMall key, own polling) are a later family. Zero point mean_k(k=1, rms_n=13), last week with a measured spread that turns out equal to the arena default. Weak point kept visible: the series is smooth, about 1 point a week, close to its noise. Two unscored go/no-go pilot Saturdays (12 and 19 December) and two unscored holiday Saturdays (26 December, 2 January) precede the first scored round on Sat 9 January 2027 (lock Thu 7 January 20:00 SGT). Rights: Open Data Licence and data.gov.sg API terms; verdict proposed 'approved', for maintainers.
question: What share of car lots (lot type C) will be occupied, in percent, across the HDB carparks located in the Clementi planning area (URA Master Plan 2019 boundary) in the Carpark Availability snapshot for Saturday 20:00 Singapore time? Occupied = total lots minus available lots, summed over carparks, divided by total lots. SSA sets and resolves this metric; no publisher releases it.

source.publisher: Housing & Development Board (HDB), via data.gov.sg: 'Carpark Availability' (d_ca933a644e55d34fe21f28b8052fac63) and 'HDB Carpark Information' (d_23f946fa557947f93a8043bbef41dd09). Boundaries: URA Master Plan 2019 Planning Area Boundary (No Sea), d_4765db0e87b9c86336792efe8a1f7a66.
source.access: Keyless: GET https://api.data.gov.sg/v1/transport/carpark-availability?date_time=YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS (Singapore time) returns items[0].timestamp and carpark_data[] with carpark_number, update_datetime (no zone, Singapore time) and carpark_info[] {lot_type, total_lots, lots_available} as text. Verified for 66 Saturdays 20:00, 2025-08-09 to 2026-11-07, one call every ~3 s plus the response time (about 15 s per 320 KB body), 2026-11-09T01:18Z-01:35Z, honest user agent: 64 first tries HTTP 200, two HTTP 504 (2025-10-25, 2025-08-23) that succeeded on the single retry after 10 s. No empty 'items' seen at this minute (the doc reports some at other minutes). Carpark to planning area: HDB Carpark Information via https://data.gov.sg/api/action/datastore_search?resource_id=d_23f946fa557947f93a8043bbef41dd09 (2,273 rows, 3 calls, 2026-11-09), x_coord/y_coord in SVY21 converted to WGS84 (SVY21 transverse Mercator inverse, origin 1.366666 N 103.833333 E, false northing 38,744.572 m, false easting 28,001.642 m) and placed in the pinned URA polygon (sha256 f23856251b467089...); 48 carparks fall in Clementi (16 multi-storey, 32 surface). The attribute table and the boundary file are archived once per season and pinned by hash. Snapshot bodies go to sources/lta-rt/carpark-hdb/<YYYY-MM-DD>/<HHMM>.json with url, fetched_at, sha256 and bytes in sources/manifest.json. GitHub runners untested (lesson 3). Mall carparks are out of this card (owner decision, rev 2: HDB only, malls later); they would need the DataMall AccountKey described in sg-lta-pv-train-jurong-east@v2 and a 5-minute scheduled poller.
source.archive_policy: Use: allowed. Automated retrieval: allowed in writing. Redistribution of archived snapshots: allowed with attribution. Evidence: Singapore Open Data Licence v1.0 ('use, access, download, copy, distribute, transmit, modify and adapt the datasets') and the data.gov.sg API Terms of Service ('use, access, call, command, query or request the API'; 'shall not mis-present or mask your API Client's identity') [verified, fetched 2026-11-09T01:01Z]. No personal data in the rows (carpark codes and counts). For malls via DataMall, the same licence plus LTA's API ToS apply, with the DataMall website Terms of Use clause of unclear scope noted in the train card. Conditions: licence notice naming all three datasets; no suggestion of HDB, URA or LTA endorsement; honest user agent. Proposed arena inventory row: rights 'approved' for the data.gov.sg route, pending maintainers. The agent does not grant it.

target.population: Car lots (lot_type 'C') at HDB carparks whose HDB Carpark Information coordinates fall inside the Clementi planning area; about 14,400 lots. Lots taken by residents (season parking) and by visitors are not distinguished.
target.window: One instant: Saturday 20:00:00 Singapore time, read as the snapshot returned for date_time=<Saturday>T20:00:00.
target.calculation: Metric definition v1, committed with a timestamp before the first window. (1) Request date_time=<Saturday>T20:00:00. (2) The snapshot is valid if items is non-empty, items[0].timestamp is no more than 120 s before 20:00:00, and it has at least 1,900 car rows (66 snapshots had 1,975-2,034). (3) Keep rows with lot_type 'C', total_lots > 0, and update_datetime no more than 60 minutes before items[0].timestamp (the doc's stale rule); a carpark with several 'C' rows counts each. (4) Keep carparks mapped to CLEMENTI by the pinned attribute table and boundary file. (5) Occupancy = 100 x sum(total_lots - lots_available) / sum(total_lots) over kept rows. If invalid, request 20:01, 20:02, 20:05 and 20:10 in turn under the same rule. Measured: healthy timestamps were 23-24 s before the minute; stale rows island-wide had a median share of 1.9% and a maximum of 14.0% (2026-06-13).

lock: Thursday 20:00 Singapore time (12:00Z), 48 hours before the target minute, as in the doc. Unscored pilot, go/no-go (G3): Sat 2026-12-12 20:00 (lock Thu 12-10) and Sat 2026-12-19 20:00 (lock Thu 12-17), resolved by the full pipeline, not counted; they check the validity and coverage rules and the 20:30 capture from GitHub runners. A maintainer gives the go/no-go after the 12-19 round resolves; no-go means the first scored round moves and the card is revised. Then two more unscored rounds, still posted and resolved but not counted: Sat 2026-12-26 and Sat 2027-01-02 (the largest measured move was the first Saturday of 2026, +6.3 points). Owner decision (2026-11-08, folded into rev 2): Christmas Day and New Year weekends are poor first scored rounds. First scored lock: Thu 2027-01-07 20:00 SGT for Sat 2027-01-09 20:00, then weekly. The pilots need the metric definition and round on main by about Mon 2026-11-23, 17 days before the first pilot lock.
baseline: Ranked zero point: persistence, the same minute one week earlier, from SSA's archive, as the doc proposes, with sd = the root-mean-square of persistence errors over the 13 most recent valid Saturdays: zero point mean_k(k=1, lag=0, rms_n=13) (owner decision, rev 2; rev 1 called it 'persistence_rms13'). Zero-point family (G1): one parameterised reference 'mean_k(k, lag, rms_n)': the mean of the k most recent eligible values in the lock capture, after skipping 'lag' newer ones not yet published, with sd = the root-mean-square of that same rule's errors over the rms_n most recent resolved targets in the lock capture (G2). Persistence is mean_k(k=1). Measured on 66 Saturdays 2025-08-09 to 2026-11-07 (past-minute snapshots fetched 2026-11-09), last 26 weeks, Clementi: persistence MAE 0.96 points, mean of the last 4 weeks 1.03; range 36.9 to 49.0%. Spread check (lesson 12), last 26 weeks: persistence with the 13-week RMS, CRPS 0.690, best free rescale gain +0.5% (k 0.85), 90% coverage 0.92; with the arena's fixed sd 1.5, CRPS 0.682: the spread is measured, and equals the default (G2), because the unit is percentage points; the rule still uses the measured spread so it does not depend on that coincidence. The 4-week mean with its own RMS: CRPS 0.689, coverage 1.00 (too wide). Holiday and shock moves, Clementi, week-on-week: 2026-01-03 +6.3, 2026-01-10 -2.6, 2026-04-04 (Easter Saturday) -2.3, 2026-08-08 (National Day eve) -2.1, 2025-12-27 +0.7, 2026-02-21 (Chinese New Year weekend) -0.6. Shown, not ranked: the 4-week mean. Other towns for comparison (last 26 weeks, persistence MAE / 4-week mean MAE, points): Tampines 0.55 / 0.44; Jurong East 2.28 / 1.70; Bishan 1.55 / 1.30; island-wide 0.40 / 0.31.
resolution: SSA fetches the target minute (and fallbacks if needed) once at Saturday 20:30 SGT and archives every body fetched; one more attempt at 22:00 SGT if the connection fails. The endpoint serves past minutes, so the later fetch reads the same snapshot. The value is computed from the first valid snapshot. The archive is the record. The round text states that SSA is both the question setter and the resolver.
missing_data_policy: (1) No valid snapshot among 20:00, 20:01, 20:02, 20:05, 20:10: the round is cancelled. (2) Fewer than 36 of the 48 pinned Clementi carparks (75%) pass the stale and total-lots rules in the resolution snapshot: cancelled (a partial town is a different number). Measured: 39 to 46 passed in each of the 66 snapshots. (3) A carpark added to the feed after the attribute table was pinned is excluded and logged; one removed is simply absent, subject to (2). (4) Fewer than 10 valid Saturdays among the last 13 in the archive: the round is not posted. (5) Rows whose lots_available exceeds total_lots are dropped and logged (none checked for in this pass).
scoring: SSA topline scoring: mean and sd or quantiles, CRPS; continuous_normal. Skill = 1 - CRPS(entrant) / CRPS(mean_k(k=1, rms_n=13)). arena scoring.noise_floor, Clementi, last 52 weeks: m 0.80 points, s 1.28, so movement exceeds noise but only just; most large towns are at or below their noise (Tampines m 0.65 s 0.53; Woodlands 1.22 / 0.59; Bedok 1.01 / 0.00; Sengkang 0.00 / 1.45). Expect small skills, as on the arena's Civiqs tasks. Also shown: skill against the 4-week mean, MAE, 50%/90% coverage.

evidence.finding: [verified 2026-11-09T01:18Z-01:35Z] 66 Saturday 20:00 snapshots, 2025-08-09 to 2026-11-07, 1,975-2,034 car rows each, timestamps 23-24 s before 20:00. Island-wide car-lot occupancy 38.3-43.2%; Clementi 36.9-49.0%. 901 carparks present every week. Sample row 2026-11-07: HE12, update_datetime 19:58:51, C: 103 available of 105. Two HTTP 504s, each fine on one retry.

[verified computation, 66 Saturdays] Town car-lot occupancy at 20:00, last 26 weeks, persistence MAE / 4-week mean MAE / noise_floor m / s (points): Sengkang 0.57 / 0.56 / 0.00 / 1.45; Jurong West 1.01 / 0.86 / 0.90 / 0.71; Tampines 0.55 / 0.44 / 0.65 / 0.53; Woodlands 1.05 / 0.92 / 1.22 / 0.59; Choa Chu Kang 1.53 / 1.37 / 1.57 / 0.79; Hougang 0.80 / 0.66; Yishun 0.94 / 0.71; Clementi 0.96 / 1.03 / 0.80 / 1.28; Jurong East 2.28 / 1.70 / 1.94 / 0.00; Bishan 1.55 / 1.30 / 1.30 / 1.29; island 0.40 / 0.31 / 0.47 / 0.34.

[verified, interpretation unverified] Construct check: the ten largest carparks present every week read, as mean occupancy at Saturday 20:00 over 26 weeks: JS3L (2,010 lots) 1.9%, DRS 2.6%, BJ63 14.7%, SB13 19.7%, SB26 24.7%, JM5 28.5%, GM1M 33.6%, JM19 33.6%, Y70M 34.6%, NT5 45.0%. Near-empty residential carparks on a Saturday night suggest that for some carparks 'lots_available' or 'total_lots' does not measure what residents park in (for example, lots reserved for season holders, or new estates). Not established; a person could ask HDB. Single-carpark questions (the doc's first proposal) are therefore risky without a per-carpark check.

[verified 2026-11-09, 30 Saturdays 2026-04-18 to 2026-11-07 at 14:00 and 20:00] Persistence MAE / noise m / movement s, points: Clementi 20:00 1.06 / 0.81 / 0.75, 14:00 1.12 / 1.00 / 0.63; island 0.39 / 0.31 / 0.21 vs 0.29 / 0.27 / 0.09; Bishan 1.41 / 1.22 / 0.57 vs 1.09 / 0.58 / 1.07; Tampines 0.56 vs 0.45; Jurong East 2.50 vs 2.32 (s 0 at both). Island-wide occupancy differs by only 2.2 points between Saturday afternoon (36.9%) and evening (39.1%), another sign that the 'available lots' count responds weakly to residents' daily trips.

[verified 2026-11-09T01:13Z] HDB Carpark Information: 2,273 rows with car_park_no, address, x_coord/y_coord (SVY21), car_park_type, type_of_parking_system, short_term_parking, free_parking, night_parking, decks, gantry_height, basement. ACB (Albert Centre) converts to 1.30106 N, 103.85412 E, as expected. 3-7 feed carparks per snapshot are not in the table.

[verified, guide v6.11] §2.12 CarParkAvailabilityv2: 'Returns no. of available lots for HDB, LTA and URA carpark data. The LTA carpark data consist of major shopping malls and developments within Orchard, Marina, HarbourFront, Jurong Lake District.' Attributes CarParkID, Area, Development, Location, AvailableLots, LotType, Agency; no total lots and no timestamp; update frequency 1 minute; AccountKey required (§1).

evidence.finding: [owner input, checked] Correct: keyless past-minute access for HDB, about 2,000 carparks, the stale-row issue, malls live-only via DataMall with no totals or timestamps. Needs fixing: (1) 'Full at night' does not match the data: island-wide occupancy at Saturday 20:00 was 38-43%, and the doc's own Monday 04:30 figure is 0.53; (2) the doc says the island mean moves little and suggests towns, but most large towns also move about as much as their noise (Tampines, Woodlands, Bedok); (3) a single named carpark can read 2% full on a Saturday night, so single-carpark questions need a per-carpark sanity check first; (4) the mall question needs 8 weeks of SSA polling every 5 minutes from a scheduled job, which the arena's 6-hourly refresh is not; this is new infrastructure.

assumptions: Owner decisions recorded in rev 2 (Claude, delegated by Haoyang Shang, 2026-11-08, DECISIONS-wave2.md): Clementi HDB occupancy share at Saturday 20:00 as written (rev-1 options A for time and unit); HDB only, malls as a later round family (option A). General: G1 one parameterised family, mean_k(k=1, rms_n=13); G2 spread measured, equals the default sd 1.5 here; G3 two unscored pilot Saturdays; G4 no person-task is required for rights. Owner decision (2026-11-08, folded into rev 2): Christmas Day and New Year weekends are poor first scored rounds. Pilots 12-12 and 12-19 are go/no-go; 12-26 and 01-02 are posted unscored; first scored Sat 2027-01-09, lock Thu 2027-01-07 20:00 SGT. Optional, not blocking, for a maintainer to send if they choose (nobody on our side sends it until then), to HDB via feedback@data.gov.sg, verbatim: 'In the Carpark Availability dataset (d_ca933a644e55d34fe21f28b8052fac63), several large HDB carparks (for example JS3L and DRS) report fewer than 5% of car lots taken on Saturday evenings. Do lots_available and total_lots cover season-parking lots as well as short-term lots, and are any lots excluded from the count?'

Town occupancy weighted by lots (sum over carparks), not the mean of per-carpark occupancies. Reason: it is the share of all the town's lots, and one small carpark cannot swing it. Runner-up: unweighted mean, as the doc's 'mean HDB occupancy' may intend.

Clementi chosen because the doc names it and it passed the movement check; the planning-area grouping uses the URA boundary, not HDB's own town list. Runner-up: Jurong East (larger moves, 2.28 points, but noise 1.94 exceeds measured movement).
Validity rules (120 s staleness, at least 1,900 car rows, 36 of 48 Clementi carparks) and the fallback minutes are the agent's choices, sized from the 66 measured snapshots. Easy to change.
Suggested arena names: series 'sg_hdb_occ_clementi_sat2000'; adapter ssa/adapters/sg_carpark.py; archive sources/lta-rt/carpark-hdb/; round_id 'sg-hdb-clementi-<YYYY-MM-DD>'. Naming only.
